clips.title: The story
paras: Stone Cairn Lake is a ring-shaped body of water resting in northeastern Elwynn Forest. At its center lies an island crowned with Heroes' Vigil, a memorial to the fallen of the First War. Once a tranquil site for reflection, the lake is now troubled by hostile murlocs along its shores and renegade wizards occupying the isle.

Stone Cairn Lake earns its name from the prominent stone memorial erected on the large island in its center. Known as Heroes' Vigil, this monument was raised to honor the heavy loss of human life suffered during the First War against the Orcish Horde. Families and pilgrims once traveled safely to the island to pay respects to the fallen, gazing across the calm waters at the solemn stonework. Today, however, dangerous renegade wizards have established a camp directly beside the memorial, turning a place of sacred remembrance into a hostile redoubt.

Surrounding the ring-shaped lake is a scenic shoreline that has grown increasingly dangerous for locals and travelers. A tribe of aggressive murlocs has claimed the southern banks, erecting crude huts along the waterline and harassing anyone who draws near. Beyond its dangers, the hills and outcrops encircling the lake are rich in mineral veins, making the perimeter a frequent destination for prospectors and miners willing to brave the local threats.
